quarterly_data.signal: In February 2026 Dominion Energy announced an updated $64.7 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026 through 2030, which includes the impact of Stonepeak's 50% noncontrolling interest in the CVOW Commercial Project, to address projected demand growth; the 10-K describes the plan as investments in zero-carbon and renewable generation, grid transformation, generation reliability and transmission and distribution resiliency. Virginia Power's transmission projects authorized by PJM under its RTEP process are expected to result in future capital expenditures of approximately $8.3 billion from 2026 through 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: $64.7 billion capex plan 2026-2030; PJM-authorized transmission projects ~$8.3 billion capex 2026-2030
